indentation: Indent the first line of paragraphs
advancedReset: Advanced · reset appearance and editor defaults
resetScope: Your materials, reading positions, tabs, APIs and backups are retained.
preferencesFailed: Settings could not be saved. You can retry.
preferencesRestoring: A backup is being restored. Change settings afterward.
localFontNameValidation: Enter a local font name between 1 and 120 characters long.
localFontPreviewNotice: Fonts will not be downloaded or embedded. Detecting a font name does not guarantee that all Chinese glyphs will use that font; check the preview.
interfaceFontUsage: Used for navigation, buttons, settings, and reference panels.
bodyFontUsage: Used for body text editing, chapter reading, and literature text; the original manuscript content stays unchanged.
studyWritingPreviewDescription: Open a chapter, look up characters, and keep writing your story.
rainAndFootstepsPreview: The rain outside had stopped. She closed her notebook and heard footsteps in the hallway.
timeAndLamplightPreview: “There’s still time,” he said. The lamp on the desk was still lit.
chooseStudyForWritingTime: Choose a study that suits your writing hours.
simpleNavigationHelp: Show daily writing entries in the sidebar. More tools and quick commands retain every existing feature.
companionVisualOnly: This skin changes visuals only. It does not make the AI roleplay a character or change its model or permissions.
companionTitle_yoshino: A quiet place for your next line.
companionText_yoshino: Soft paper and a calm garden. Whether you write a sentence or a chapter, your creative space is here.
companionText_rem: There is no need to finish every story today. Return to your chapter and give one small idea room to grow.
companionText_desk: Writing first; a gentle presence beside it.
companionText_assistant: Actions need real receipts; changes need your approval.
companionText_scene: The visual companion is separate from scene characters. Character actions still follow authorized scene knowledge.
companionResourceHelp: Personal portraits load from companion/manifest.json in the application data directory. Place Yoshino and Rem portraits beside it, enter the filenames, then reload portraits. The welcome area, bookshelf, assistant and roleplay share these slots. Rem day and night use the same portrait.
companionLocalOnly: Only these two local portrait slots are read. No remote image is requested. Personal artwork stays in your data directory; public builds contain explicit placeholders only.
themeDescription_yoshino: Soft pink, warm gold, a quiet presence
themeDescription_rem: Clear blue, soft paper, gentle company
l2d_unmappedEmotion: No model mapping for this emotion
l2d_projectIsolated: Conversation and memories are scoped to this novel; full novel content is not read
l2d_personalIsolated: Personal conversation; no novel or document access
l2d_realModelMissing: This character's real Live2D model is missing
l2d_notPng: A complete moc3, model3, textures, motions and expressions are required. A static PNG is not a dynamic model.
l2d_sampleOnly: Official Haru technical sample; not Yoshino or Rem.
l2d_startChat: Say something. Text chat works even without a character model.
l2d_messageHint: Chat or request writing advice. Full novel content is not read by default.
l2d_voiceNotice: Uses installed Windows synthetic voices, not original actors. No actor voice cloning or download.
l2d_visemeMissing: Viseme events unavailable for this voice
l2d_actionsNotice: The character proposes browsing actions. Your click invokes existing Actions; success requires a real receipt.
l2d_memoryNotice: Author-confirmed for this character and scope only; never novel Canon.
l2d_mappingNotice: Choose mappings based on actual model behavior. Unmapped emotions do not trigger fabricated actions.
l2d_importNotice: Complete Cubism 3 runtime packages and license notes only; no scripts or voice files. Private models stay out of public archives.
l2d_rightsConfirm: Confirm you have permission to use this model locally and that its character identity is correct. Import does not grant redistribution rights. Continue?
l2d_importDetails: Enter a model name and license source first
l2d_presence: A little company while you write
l2d_quietCompany: Tap the character to interact, or send a message when you want to chat.
l2d_tapHint: Tap the character or select a motion or expression available in this model.
l2d_petDragHint: Drag the character or this handle; arrow keys also move it
l2d_petPassthroughHint: Let clicks reach your writing; the toolbar stays interactive
l2d_petHelp: Drag the name bar or model to reposition. Click or right-click for application actions.
l2d_advanced_duet_note: Separate shared scene: one reply per character per request. Private conversations and memories are not imported. No automatic continuation.
l2d_advanced_no_selection: Select a passage in the editor first.
l2d_advanced_voice_missing: Choose an installed voice in this character’s settings first.
l2d_advanced_unsupported: This model lacks the required body rig. No substitute motion was played.
l2d_advanced_quiet_done: Quiet company enabled; no automatic messages or speech.
l2d_advanced_rate_limit: AI service rate or quota limit (429). Local interaction remains available; the provider was not changed.
